title: Fever and temperature documentation
content: Fever narratives and measured temperature entries describe different aspects of a record. A synthetic narrative may mention feeling warm without supplying a thermometer value. Temperature observations preserve unit, collection time, device context, and source when available. An organism test has its own result status and specimen provenance; absence of that test does not establish an infectious cause. Retrieval tasks focus on these documentation distinctions. The fictional text does not decide why a temperature was recorded or assign an infection label. No management pathway is represented. Synthetic research evidence only. Retrieval relevance != clinical validity.
